description: Locale configuration for Luxembourgish (lb) in Moment.js, including functions for relative time, calendar formatting, and locale-specific rules.

methods.name: processRelativeTime
methods.description: Processes relative time strings based on the key and context.

methods.name: processFutureTime
methods.description: Prepends 'a' or 'an' to future time strings based on linguistic rules.

methods.name: processPastTime
methods.description: Prepends 'viru' or 'virun' to past time strings based on linguistic rules.

methods.name: eifelerRegelAppliesToNumber
methods.description: Determines if the Luxembourgish linguistic rule applies to a given number, affecting article usage.
